## Deliverables

Submit these in the `project` folder of your course repo (`bwai-f27/bwai-netID`):

- A link to a **GitHub repository** containing your project and all of its
  source files.
- A link to your **5-minute video** about your project, posted to YouTube.
- Your **agent transcripts** and a **token usage report**.

The final project is graded 0 / 0.5 / 1 using the
[final project rubric](../syllabus.qmd#final-project-rubric). A few projects will
be showcased at the start of the final exam.
